description: Internal: newest screencast frame, or nothing when since_frame is still current. No capture round-trip; poll fast. Not an agent function.

since_frame.description: Frame cursor from the previous read; when the newest frame still has this seq the response omits `frame` (nothing changed, nothing to redraw).

active.description: False when no screencast is running (call screencast::start first).

frame.description: Base64 JPEG of the newest frame; absent when `since_frame` is still current or no frame has arrived yet.

height.description: Page-viewport height the frame maps to.

width.description: Page-viewport width the frame maps to (input coordinate space).
